notes.title: Demo Update #1
notes.notes: [p]Hi treasure seekers![/p][p][/p][p]We hope you're all enjoying BALL x PIT demo![/p][p]We're rolling out a small patch for the demo, so make sure to update the game before your next session.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Patch Notes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Projectiles and player now use 3D colliders, so being hitboxes match visuals a bit better. There will still be a bit of leniency as the player's hitbox will be much narrower than the character. [/p][/*][*][p]Add setting to disable swirling background in fuser ui [/p][/*][*][p]Let boss crown flash even if 'reduce flashing colors' is enabled [/p][/*][*][p]Adjust freeze damage color to be less cyan [/p][/*][*][p]Increase/decrease game speed is now remappable on the keyboard [/p][/*][*][p]Various Bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]That's all for now! We encourage you to [url="https://discord.gg/BALLxPIT"]join our Discord[/url] server to report bugs, give feedback, and share suggestions with us.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your support![/p]
